source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB entry getter; high-level sel list does not preserve raw reservation/record semantics.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x0A/0x43 with zero reservation, one-byte placeholder record ID, offset0, length FF; clear logs.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE after correcting two-byte ID and reservation/offset semantics.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Preserve repository; no clear or implicit delete.

original_test_intent: Read and decode one identified SEL record, including next-record linkage and complete event fields, without mutation.
original_method: Issue Storage 0x0A/0x43 with reservation, two-byte record ID, offset and byte count.
manual_activity: Owner supplies selected record ID, OEM mappings and expected event semantics once.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: sel list is only a display cross-check and cannot replace raw record-ID/reservation evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected 0x0A/0x43 with validated two-byte IDs and bounded offset/count, then decode the returned record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source placeholder and timing preserved; missing high record-ID byte is documented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Read exactly one identified record or bounded sequence with raw linkage and schema-aware decoding.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects record-ID width and adds reservation and record-type handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: High-level list can normalize or omit bytes and reservation failures.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Concurrent SEL changes can invalidate IDs or iteration order.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/high-level entry is equivalent only with stable record identity, all fields, timestamps and raw provenance.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title/command align; the one-byte placeholder is an incomplete parameterization corrected in Review.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read semantics are defined; record/OEM inputs are readiness data.

review_improvement: Restores two-byte identity, reservation lifecycle and raw event decoding that sel list hides.
independent_technical_reasoning: SEL record identity and next-record ID are two-byte little-endian values, while concurrent writes can cancel a reservation or change traversal. Therefore each response must be bound to the requested ID and repository context; a rendered list cannot substitute for exact raw bytes or prove completeness.

source_provenance.history: Exact-code, reservation and SEL mutation search
